about_the_game:
A one-button rhythm mini-game anthology!

Featuring diverse art styles and a wide variety of Brazilian musical genres, hit every note and become a RhythMaster!

RhythMania uses a one-button mechanic inspired by classic console rhythm games, creating an experience that is quick to start and easy to play for both new players and longtime fans.

With original music ranging from bossa nova to samba, axé, pagode, and funk, and visuals by award-winning Brazilian artists, every mini-game brings a fresh burst of rhythm and color!



Features:

  • Instant gameplay: Launch and start playing in seconds. Perfect for short bursts or longer sessions.

  • Dozens of mini-games: Master the rhythm across a wide range of themes – from flying kites to replying to lively group chats, loading moving trucks, rescuing stuck balls at the school gym, and more.

  • Supermixes: Push your skills with mashups that combine multiple stages into more demanding rhythm challenges.

  • Flexible controls: Play with keyboard, mouse, or your favorite controller.

  • Achievements: Unlock goals by clearing stages, setting new records, and taking on extra challenges.

    Press, play, and master the beat in RhythMania!
